tei:div.tei:p: (ya)༄༅// snyan ngag me long gi 'grel pa dbyangs can rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos me long zhes bya ba'i le'u dang po gsal bar byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa dbyangs can gyi rol mtsho zhes bya ba/ rig byed rnam bzhi'i zhal gyi skyed tshal du// rig gnas rnam bzhi'i mtshems dkar sbrang rtsi la// rol rtsed rnam bzhi'i sgeg ldan dbyangs can ma// tha snyad rnam bzhi'i spobs pa 'dir stsol cig /ra mā shar ma la sogs pa'i// bstan bcos btus nas snyan dngags kyi// me long bstar ba ji bzhin du// de nang shar ba'i legs bshad kyi// ri mo ma nyams 'dir bstan bya// 'di na kun tu mchog rnams kyang*// mchog gi rjes su bstan pa yi// tshig rnams nyid kyi drin gyis ni// tha snyad gzhung la 'jug par byed// don dang tshig bzang snyan dngags kyi// snang byed rnar snyan yid 'ongs 'dis// 'jig rten gsum po'i blo gros kyi// mun pa mtha' dag sel bar byed// sngon gyi sa skyong skye rgu'i mgon// de dag nye bar mi bzhugs kyang*// de yi grags pa'i me long du// legs byas nyams pa med 'di'o// de bzhin 'di ni dbyangs can gyis// rjes bzung rnams kyi bstan bcos kyang*// ngag gi dbang phyug la dga' ba'i// 'dod pa 'jo ba'i khyu mchog yin// sngon gyi bstan bcos mi shes par// nyes bshad sbyar ba'i snyan dngags kyi// rjes 'jug lha rnams dga' ba yi// brtul zhugs mchog la sbyor bar byed// de phyir snyan dngags dag la skyon// chung bar gyur kyang ji zhig ltar// btang snyoms mi bya lus mdzes kyang*// skyon gcig gis ni skal ngan 'gyur// skye bo bstan bcos mi shes pas// yon tan skyon dag ji ltar dbye// gzugs kyi dbye ba dmigs pa'i skabs// long ba dag la yod dam ci// de phyir mkhas pas ma 'ongs pa'i// skye bo rnams kyang mkhas bya'i phyir// rnam bkra lam ldan tshig rnams kyi// bya ba'i cho ga nges par sbyar// snyan dngags lus dang rgyan gyis bsdus// lus la gzhung gi dbye bas gsum// skad kyi dbye bas rnam pa bzhi// sbyor tshul sgo nas gnyis su phye// dang po tshigs bcad lhug pa dang*// spel ma rnam pa gsum yin no// tshigs bcad mtshan nyid dbye ba dang*// snyan dngags chen po ngos bzung nas// rtsom tshul mi 'dra bshad par bya// sa skya paṇa chen tshigs bcad dang*// lhug pa spel ma gsum ga la// rgyun chags sdeb sbyor srid par bzhed// de yang sdeb sbyor tshoms las ni// rkang pa dag gis ma bcad cing*// gang la yi ge sbrel legs yod// bya ba'i tshig gis gsal byas pa// de ni rgyun chags las gzhan min// zhes pa khungs su 'dren par mdzad// dpang lo khungs 'di med ces zer// me long gzhung 'dir rgyun chags dang*// rab bsags tshigs bcad nang du bsdus// sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas las// yi ge nyer bdun phan chad ni// rgyun chags dang ni cha bsags te// gnyis po'i khyad par ra dang ni// ma yi 'phel ba dag las dbye// de re re la rnam pa brgyad// gtum pa'i char 'bebs chu rgyun dang*// rgya mtsho sbrul dang char sprin dang*// rol pa'i 'byung nas shin tu klubs// dung zhes bya ba rnams su bshad// 'on kyang rgyun chags rkang pa yis// bcad dang ma bcad rnam pa gnyis// ma bcad pa dang 'dir bshad pa'i// spel ma don gcig lus su 'gyur// dang po mtshan nyid dbye ba'o// rkang pa bzhi can de'i mtshan nyid// lung gzhan las ni rkang gcig nas// rkang drug ldan pa'i bar du gsungs// dbye ba sdeb sbyor sgo nas gnyis// sbyor tshul sgo nas bzhir 'byed do// bri ta dzā ti zhes rnam gnyis// 'phel dang bskyed pa zhes bya'o// sa skya pa yis 'jug pa dang*// rigs zhes bya bar bsgyur ba yin// dbyangs yig bgrangs pa bri ta ste// phyi mo bgrangs pa dzā ti yin// dbyangs thung phyi mo re re dang*// ring ba phyi mo gnyis su dang*// shin tu ring dang pū ta dang*// phyi mo gsum gsum dag tu bgrang*// sdeb sbyor rig de snyan dngags kyi// rgya mtsho sgrol 'dod rnams kyi gru// brjod tshul sgo nas phye ba la// dbye ba so so'i mtshan nyid do// dang po grol ba rigs dang mdzod// 'dus pa zhes bya rnam pa bzhi// ngos 'dzin me long du ma bshad// mkhas 'jug sgo las gsungs 'di ltar// tshigs bcad gcig gis brjod bya'i don// rdzogs pa grol ba yin par 'dod// tshigs bcad phan tshun 'dus pa las// brjod bya rdzogs pa rigs zhes bya// gnas skabs gcig la yul tha dad// bya ba tha dad ston pa mdzod// yang na tshigs bcad gcig gis ni// brjod bya mang po ston pa'o// yul gcig bya ba du ma yis// bsngags pa tshogs pa yin par 'dod// yang na tshigs bcad mang po yis// brjod bya'i don gcig ston pa'o// gnyis pa snyan dngags chen po ni// sarga zhes pa le'u ste// le'us bcings pa'i tshigs bcad la// snyan dngags chen po zhes brjod do// de yi sbyor ba bstan pa la// dang por rtsom gyi sgo dbye dang*// bar du lus kyi gnas tshul dang*// tha mar rtsom pa'i tshul bstan pa'o// shis brjod phyag bya dngos po ni// nges par bstan pa de yi sgo// tshangs pa'i zhal gyi padma yi// rig byed sbrang rtsi gzhibs mkhas pa// dbyangs can bung bas bdag blo yi// ge sar g.yo ba med par mdzod// ces pa lta bu shis brjod do// rtog pa'i drwa ba bsal ba dang*// zab dang rgya che'i mkhyen pa yis// gzhan gyi don la 'bad med par// 'jug mdzad de la phyag bgyi'o// zhes pa phyag bya'i dper brjod do// rab gsal mkhyen gsum ljon pa la// sbyor bzhi'i me tog 'dzum phreng can// chos sku phrin las bcas pa yi// 'bras bu smin mdzad rgyal ba'i yum// zhes pa dngos po bstan pa'i sgo// gnyis pa las kyi gnas tshul la// skyes pa rabs kyi sde lta bu// sngon byung gtam las gyur pa'am// kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar bzhin// gcig shos legs pa la brten pa'i// chos 'dod nor dang thar pa ste// sde bzhi'i 'bras bu dbang gyur dang*// mkhas shing yid 'ong rgyal po dang*// grong khyer rgya mtsho ri dang dus// nyi zla 'char ba'i bsngags pa dang*// skyed tshal chu yi rol rtsed dang*// chang 'thung dga' ba'i dga' ston dang*// slu ba dang ni bag ma dang*// gzhon nu skye dang 'phel ba dang*// gros dang pho nya bgrod pa dang*// g.yul dang rgyal po dar bas kyang*// rgyan gyur ha cang bsdus min pa'o// gsum pa rtsom pa'i tshul bshad pa// dngos dang rtsom lugs so so'o// nyams dang 'gyur ba dag gis gtam// sarga shin tu rgya che min// snyan 'os bri ta dzā ti yi// sdeb sbyor gyis bcings le'u'i mthar// dkyus ma dag dang mi mthun pa'i// sdeb sbyor sbyar bas 'jig rten pa// blo dang ldan rnams dga' bar byed// snyan dngags dam pa'i rgyan ldan ni// bskal pa'i bar du gnas par gyur// gong du bshad pa'i yon tan las// yan lag 'ga' zhig dman na yang*// gal te sbyar ba phun tshogs kyi// de rig mgu bar byed pa na// 'dir ni snyan dngags skyon ma yin// rtsom lugs so sor bstan pa ni// snyan dngags mkhan po bha ha ma// thog mar rgyal po yon tan gyis// nye bar bkod pa de nas ni// dgra la gnod pa byed ces pa'i// lam de rang bzhin mdzes pa yin// me long mdzad pa rang nyid ni// rigs dang brtson 'grus thos sogs kyis// dgra bo dag kyang bsngags byas nas// de la rgyal phyir rgyal po ni// khyad 'phags brjod pas bdag dga' skyed// gnyis pa lhug pa'i rnam gzhag la// mtshan nyid dbye ba gzhan gyi ni// 'dod lugs dgag pa gsum bshad bya// rkang pa med pa'i tshig rgyun ni// mtshan nyid de yi dbye ba ni// brjod dang gtam zhes bya ba gnyis// sngon byung gtam rgyus las drangs dang*// de las drangs sam ma drangs kyang*// rang nyid ngag gis brjod pa ni// gnyis po'i khyad par yin par bshad// gzhan gyi 'dod lugs 'gog pa ni// rang gis rang gi yon tan yang*// ji bzhin bsngags pa brjod pa ste// gal te rang ngam gzhan gyis kyang*// ji bzhin min par brjod pa gtam// zhes 'di bha ma ha yi lugs// de yang nges pa med mthong ste// der yang gzhan gyis brjod mthong phyir// gzhan gyis brjod dam rang gis shes// dbye ba'i rgyu ni ci zhig 'dri// gal te sgo dang gzhan sgo dang*// yid brtan ldan nyid brjod pa ni// tha dad pa yi rtags yin na// gtam rnams dag la'ang sgo dang ni// gzhan gyi sgo rnams cis mi 'jug

/'phags pa'i dbyangs sogs sdeb sbyor bzhin// lam bha sogs dang ā shā sa'i// dbye ba mthong phyir 'gal zhe na// ming gi dbye ba tsam yin gyi// lhag ma thams cad brjod par 'dus// lam bha zhes pa gzhon nu ma// snyed dang ā shā sa zhes pa// yid brtan thob pa'i skad yin no// bha ma ha sogs gzhan na re// bu mo 'phrog pa'i bsngags pa dang*// dus btab gyur kyang bslus pa dang*// rgyal po mnga' thang dar ba sogs// brjod pa la yod gtam la med// ce na bu mo 'phrogs pa dang*// bslu dang dar ba la sogs la// sargas bcings pa thams cad la// yod phyir khyad par dbye mi nus// snyan dngags mkhan po'i bsam pa yis// brtags nas brjod pa de dag ni// gtam la'ang sbyar kyang skyon ma yin// 'dod don sgrub la snyan dngags kyi// rgyan du mi 'gyur ci yang med// de phyir gtam la'ang sgo sogs sbyar// gsum pa spel ma zlos gar sogs// tshigs bcad lhug par bsres pa ste// tsam pu zhes pa'i ming can no// gnyis pa skad kyi dbye ba ni// ngag gi rang bzhin de dag kyang*// legs sbyar de bzhin rang bzhin dang*// zur chag 'dren ma zhes bya bzhi// sha za'i skad kyang 'di la bshad// legs sbyar zhes pa lha yi ni// skad du drang srong chen pos gsungs// de skyes de mtshungs yul can zhes// du ma rang bzhin dag gi rim// yul 'khor chen po la brten skad// legs brjod rin chen dag gi mtsho// sargas bcings sogs gang las byung*// rang bzhin mchog tu gyur par rigs// so sor se sogs yul can gyi// skad rnams rang bzhin nyid ces bya// zur chag gi ni rnam grangs la// snyan dngags pa la grags pa dang*// sgra yi bstan bcos la grags pa'o// dang po gnag rdzi sogs kyi tshig /snyan dngags pa la zur chag nyid// brda sprod pa ni legs sbyar las// gzhan pa zur chag nyid du brjod// so so'i mtshan nyid bstan pa ni// legs sbyar sargas bcings pa sogs// rang bzhin kandha ka la sogs// zur chag o sa ra sogs te// zlos gar la sogs 'dres pa'o// gtam sogs skad ni thams cad dang*// legs sbyar gyis kyang bcings pa ste// rmad byung don can rgya mtsho'i gtam// 'byung po'i skad kyi rang bzhin brjod// kandha o sa ra zhes dang*// rmad byung don chen rgya che ba// bstan bcos so so'i ming du 'dod// gsum pa sbyor tshul lus gnyis so// sgeg dang rol dang gom stabs sogs// mig gis blta ba'i don can dang*// rna bar snyan pa'i ro nyams can// snyan par bya ba nyid ces pa// 'di yang lugs gnyis dag tu brjod// gnyis la rgyan gyi khyad par la// thun mong thun mong min pa gnyis// thun mong min pa'i rgyan rnams ni// le'u 'og ma dag tu 'chad// 'dir ni thun mong rgyan bshad pa// snyan dngags sbyor mkhas lho pa dang*// shar ba'i lam srol mang mod kyang*// mtha' dag me long du ma brjod// rgyan gyi khyad par 'dir brjod bya// sbyar ba rab dang mnyam nyid dang*// snyan dang shin tu gzhon pa dang*// don gsal ba dang rgya che dang*// brjid dang mdzes dang ting nge 'dzin// yon tan 'di bcu bai darbha'i// lam gyi srog tu bshad pa yin// 'di dag phal cher bzlog pa yis// gau ṭā'i lam dag mtshon par byed// dang po mtshan nyid bzlog zla dang*// sbyar ba'i dpe yis bshad par bya// srog chung yi ge shes cher sbyar// de yang ha cang lhod min zhes// lho phyogs pa dag de ltar 'dod// lhod pa kho na'i sbyor ba ni// sbyar ba can zhes shar phyogs pa// srog chung zhes pa sde pa lnga'i// dang po lnga dang gsum pa lnga// lnga pa lnga dang mthar gnas bzhi// de las gzhan pa srog chen te// brjod pa rlung shugs che bas so// lhod pa zhes pa la li gnyis// srog chung gzhan dang bsres pa'o// dper na mā lā ti mā lā// lo lā li ka li lā'o// dzā ti'i phreng ba mā lā ti// mā lā phreng ba lo la ster// a li ka ni bung ba ste// li lā 'khor ram lci ba'o// srog chung yi ge shas che bar// lci ba bsres pa sbyar ba'i dper// lho pas 'dod pa 'di lta ste// mā la ti dā ma/

laṃ ghi taṃ bhra ma raiḥ /dzā ti me tog mā la ti// dā ma phreng ba lam ghi tam// 'khor zhing lding ba bhra ma raiḥ /bung ba rnams ni zhes pa'o// rab dang mtshan nyid dper brjod dang*// bzlog zla gsum gyis bshad par bya// grags shing go bar sla ba ni// rab dang zhes bya'i mtshan nyid do// dbyangs can sor gdub bung ba ni// tam bu ra yi dar dir can// de 'dra go bar sla ba'i dpe// shar pa rab tu ma grags kyang*// sgra bshad tshang tsam dang ba'i dpe// lag ldan 'khod pa'i chos kyi khri// legs bshad se gol gtogs sgra snyan// zhes pa sgra bshad yod pa'i dpe// mnyam pa mtshan nyid dper brjod dang*// bzlog zla gsum gyis bshad par bya// yi ge 'jam rtsub bar ma yi// sbyor ba mi mnyam dang bral ba// lho pas mnyam pa'i mtshan nyid 'dod// shar pa yi ge mi mnyam yang*// don dang rgyan gyi bkod pa ni// rab mnyam de yi mtshan nyid bzhed// 'jam pa ka tsa ṭa ta sogs// rtsub pa gha dzha ḍha dha bha// de gnyis mnyam par bsres pa ni// khu byug ca co sgrog byed cing*// nyar ma rab 'thor dang zhing dwangs// chu rgyun chu thigs kyis bran pa'i// mā la ya rlung bdag la 'ong*// yi ge 'jam rtsub mi mnyam yang*// don rgyan mnyam pa'i dper brjod ni// tsandan gyis bsgos dri ldang zhing*// 'jam pa ma la ya yi rlung*// bdag gi brtan 'gog dga' ma ni// mchog gi kha yi rlung dang 'gran// pad dkar 'jam pa'i 'dab ma la// rdo rje khro bo khros pa'i gdong*// la lar bzhad pa'i dkar mdangs can// hūm̐ phaṭa drag po'i phem sgra sgrog /ces pa 'jam rtsub bsres pa'i dpe// rgya mtsho dbu pa'i rlabs phreng can// margad bcag pa'i mdangs 'phro ba// de drung dri bzhon rta brgya yis// mgyogs par bos pa'i tsandan dri// zhes 'di tshig sbyor rab rtsub kyang*// don 'jam ldan pa'i dpe yin no// snyam pa mtshan nyid dper brjod dang*// grong tshig spangs pa gsum gyis bshad// mtshan nyid sgra dang don gyi ni// nyams dang ldan pa'i snyan dngags so// lho pa 'dod pa'i sgra nyams ni// rgyal ba 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// de la rab tu dad byas na// de tshe mngon mtho'i bde thob cing*// de nas rim gyis legs pa 'byung*// zhes sogs phyi ma'i tshig shugs kyis// snga ma'i tshig rnams 'dren pa ni// bai darbha'i sgra nyams te// rjes khri mi 'dod pa'ang min// gau ṭā pa dag rjes khrid nyid// sgra yi nyams su 'dod pa'o// de la rjes khrid dngos dang ni// zhar byung zung ldan bshad pa'o// yi ge gcig nyid rkang pa'am// tshigs su bcad la lan mang 'khor// rjes khrid zhes bya'i mtshan nyid de// dbye na rkang pa la bskor dang*// tshig la bskor dang ring ba yi// rjes khrid ces bya rnam pa gsum// lho shar gnyis kyi thun mong ste// shar pa kho na'i lugs dang bzhi// lha dbang dkon mchog gsum bsten na// mi dbang bzhin du kun gyis bkur// tshangs dbang gtsug gi nor bu yis// zhabs dbang rgyun du len par 'gyur// zhes ni rkang pa la bskor ba'i// rjes khrid ces pa'i dpe mtshon byed// la la'i gsung snyan la lar snyan pa la// la la'i tshig gi bde bde byas nas bde// dga' dga'i gtam gyis dga' dga' byas na dga'// bzung bzung min par bzung bzung bskyar gyir bzung*// zhes 'di tshig la bskor ba yi// rjes khrid ces bya'i dpe yin no// dge legs chos 'di yid la goms byas na// gnas skabs dge zhing gong nas gong du dge

/rang gzhan chos la rang bzhin med goms pas// bdag gzhan chos la bdag lta'i nyes mi 'byung*// zhes pa yi ge mang po yis// bar du chod pa'i rjes khrid do// don gcig tshigs bcad gcig gi nang*// lan gnyis 'das pa'i dang po rtsub// gnyis pa lhod pa'i rjes khrid ni// shar pa kho na'i 'dod de dper// 'gro mang gdung nas gdung ba skyi g.ya' zhing*// zhi ba'i bde la 'dod pa'i me chen 'bar// 'gro la brtse ba'i brtse bas lus 'tsho zhing*// myang 'das zhi ba'i bde bas yid rab brlan// zhar byung zung ldan zhes bya ba// de yang rjes khrid yin mod kyi// gcig tu snyan pa min pa'i phyir// de yi rnam gzhag 'dir mi 'chad// gnyis pa don mnyam zhes bya ba// sgra nyams sbyar ram ma sbyar kyang*// don nyams phun sum tshogs pa ni// don gyi rang bzhin brjod mkhas pa'i// bstan bcos kun la rgyal srid nyid// skabs 'di dang ni skabs gzhan du'ang*// grong pa'i tshig dag spang bar bya// de la spyir btang dmigs bsal gnyis// spyir btang don dang sgra dag la// grong tshig zhugs pa'i dbye bas gnyis// dang po bsgribs dang ma bsgribs gnyis// tshig mdzes gzhan gyis ma bsgribs pa'i// rang gi grong tshig spang bya ba// 'dod ldan dag la gzhon nu ma// khyod ni ji ltar 'dod mi byed// ces pa'o bsgribs pa'i grong tshig ni// g.yon mig g.yo ldan gtum mo ni// nges par bdag la brtse med ma// khyod la kho bo khro med ces// grong pa'i don min ro dang ldan// grong don zhugs pa khyad med kyang*// tshig nyams ldan pas bsgribs pa'i phyir// ro ldan 'di ni la lar dge /sgra la grong tshig zhugs pa la// gcod mtshams nyes dang tshig gcig ni// go bya gnyis la 'jug pa'o// de dag rim bzhin bshad bya ba// yā bha wa taḥsri yā zhes// brjod na gang khyod dga' ma la// 'khrig ldan mar ni 'khrul ba bzhin// yā ni gang yin bha wa taḥ

/khyod yin sri yā ni dga' ma// de yi gcod mtshams nyes gyur na// yā bha 'khrig pa wa taḥldan// zhes byar 'khrul pa'i skabs srid do// mi pho mtshan bzangs rgyas khyod kyi// chos dga' ma la lhag par brtse// zhes dang mi mo mtshan bzang bas// khyim gnyis su ni dga' ba bskyed// khyim bya lce gnyis pa de yis// mdza' ba so sor 'byed par byed// ces pa go bar sla ba'i dpe// gzhan la bsnun pa'i skye bo ni// birya ldan pa bi shrānta// zhes pa go bya gnyis kyi dpe// brtson 'grus ldan pa rnam par gnas// khu ba ldan pa rnam par ngal// zhes pa gnyis ka tshig 'dis go /gang zhig gang gang la dga' ba// de de 'bad pas sgrub par byed// ces pa go bar sla ba'i dpe// gnyis pa dmigs kyis bsal ba ni// gang la go bya gnyis yod kyang*// skabs kyis spang mi dgos pa yod// bha ga zhes pa mtshan ma dang*// skal ba gnyis ka la 'jug kyang*// sring mo bstod pa'i skabs dag tu// bha ga wa tī bha gi zhes// brjod pa sring mo skal ldan du// go yi sring mo mtshan ldan zhes// go ba min phyir skyon min no// shin tu gzhon pa mtshan nyid dang*// dper brjod gnyis kyis rtogs par bya// rtsub min yi ge mang ba 'dir// shin tu gzhon pa nyid du 'dod// lho pa'i lugs kyi dper brjod ni// sprin gyi phreng ba ldan dus su// snyan par sgrog pa'i mgrin ldan ma// rma bya yi ni mjug ma dag /zlam por byas nas gar byed do// zhes 'di don dang rgyan gnyis ka /rgyas par yod pa ma yin yang*// ngag tu brjod de rna bar snyan// de phyir shin tu gzhon pa'o// yi ge 'jam pa kho na ni// sbyor ba lhod pa'i skyon du bshad// gnyis pa shar phyogs pa dag ni// de de kho nar ma zad kyi// ngag tu brjod pa mi bde yang*// don gsal gyur na gzhon pa yi// snyan dngags lam du 'dod pa yin// rgyal po sgra sta rā ma ṇas// rgyal rigs gzhan dag nyams pa byas// zhes sogs rna bar rtsub tshig gis// don gang gsal bar brjod rnams so// drug pa don gsal bshad pa la// dngos dang bzlog zla bshad pa'o// dang po mtshan nyid dper brjod do// rgyu mtshan gzhan la mi ltos par// de don gsal por go mtshan nyid// sa chen rgya mtshor bying ba na// 'phrog byed phag par sprul pa yi// rmig pas brdzis pa'i klu khrag gis// dmar por byas pa'i mtsho nas bton// zhes pa dmar po'i rgyu mtshan ni// brtag mi dgos par gsal ba'o// gnyis pa bzlog pa'i dper brjod ni// phag pa chen po dag gis sa// chu gter dmar po dag las phyung*// zhes pa dmar po'i rgyu mtshan ni// slar yang blo yis brtag dgos shing*// sgra dang rigs pa la 'gongs pas// shugs kyis rtogs pa'ang ma yin pa// 'di 'dra don dang snyan ngag tu// lam srol gnyis kas 'dod ma yin// bdun pa rgya che ba la gnyis// lho pa'i lugs dang shar pa'i 'o// dang po mtshan nyid dper brjod do// dngos su tshigs 'ga' brjod pa las// shugs la khyad 'phags don mtshon pa// rgya che zhes bya'i mtshan nyid de// 'di 'dra snyan dngags lam gyi mgon// dper brjod yid 'ongs 'di ltar yod// slong ba rnams kyis bkren pa'i mig

/lan gcig khyod gdong la lhung ba// lha gcig gnas skabs de yis slar// gzhan gyi gdong la blta ma yin// zhes pas gtong phod rgya che ba// legs par mtshon no gzhan dag kyang*// rigs pas mtshungs rnams dpag par bya// rtag tu pha rol gyis gtses pa'i// kha zhan ma las khyod gcig la// skyabs song gzhan gyi gdong pa dang*// rang sems dman la rtog mi dgos// zhes pa dpa' dpung ldan par mtshon// shar phyogs pa dag bsngags 'os la// bsngags pa rgya che'i don du 'dod// rtsed 'jo'i dus su chu skyes la// bsngags 'os khrus kyi 'jug ngogs su// rgya mtsho bsngags 'os dga' ston tshe// gser gyi rgyan sogs bsngags par 'os// brgyad pa brjid pa lho pa dang*// shar pa'i dbye bas bstan par bya// dang po mtshan nyid dper brjod do// tshigs bcad lhug pa gang yang rung*// 'bru mang po dang zlas dbye dang*// de yi skyes bu la sogs pa// tshig sdud mang po can mtshan nyid// de la lci dang yangs ba rnams// mang dang nyung ba nyid spel bas// rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs ji bzhin du// mtho dang dma' ba'i rnam pa can// de la tshig gi bsdu ba ni// mang po dgos sogs dper brjod pa// nub kyi ri mgor lhung ba yi// mtha' dag nyi 'od mal stan can// mkhregs pa'i nu ma la gnas pa'i// gos dmar g.yo zhing chu ldan ma// zhes pa'i tshig sdud mang po can// lhug par ma zad tshigs bcad la'ang*// shar phyogs pa dag sbyor bar byed// go bar sla ba 'di ltar sbyar// na chung nu ma mkhregs pa la// g.yog pa'i gos dmar ji bzhin du// chu bdag phyogs kyi na gzhon ni// thun mtshams sprin gyi gos dmar can// gnyis pa lho pa'i lugs bshad pa// lci yang 'khrugs pa ma yin par// mdzes shing yid 'ong brjid par 'dod// chu 'dzin ngos kyi phang na chags// mtshams kyi nyi 'od gos dang ldan// chu ldan ma yis su yi yid// 'dod pas gzir ba byed mi 'gyur// zhes pa saṃ skṛ ta yi skad// lci yang 'khrugs pa ma yin par// lho phyogs snyan dngags mkhan dbang 'dod// skabs 'dir zhar byung lci yang ni// rin chen 'byung gnas las gsungs pa// brtsegs pa'i thog mar gang byung dang*// tsheg drag can dang thig le can// rkang mtha'i yi ge ring po rnams// 'di dag lci bar bstan pa yin// ring ba rnam pa gsum yin te// ring chas ring por mtshon pa dang*// mtshams sbyar kho nas ring gyur dang*// plu ta yis ni mtshon pa'o// 'di rnams ring dang shin tu ring*// ha cang ring po zhes brjod do// l̥̄ yig ring po rgyud med phyir// de la plu ta mi sbyar// thung du plu tas brgyan pa// shin tu ring po yin par bshad// dgu pa mdzes pa'i snyan dngags la// bai darbha la mdzes pa dang*// gau ṭā pa la mdzes pa'o// dang po mtshan nyid dbye ba dang*// dper brjod gsum gyis bshad par bya// mtshan nyid 'jig rten la grags pa'i// don la ma 'das yid 'phrog pa'o// dbye ba sngon gyi gtam brgyud las// drangs dang bsngags 'os bsngags pa'o// dper brjod rim pa bzhin bstan pa// dka' thub phung po khyod 'dra yi// zhabs kyi rdul ni gtsang ma rnams// yang dag btab pa gang yin pa// de dag kho na nges par khyim// bkra shis dge mtshan ldan pa'o// skyon med lus can khyod kyi ni// lag pa'i 'khril shing bar dag tu// nu ma rab rgyas 'di dag gi

/go skabs rnyed par gyur ma yin// de 'dra'i nyams de 'jig rten na// srid phyir 'jig rten la mdzes pa'o// gau ṭā ba yi mdzes pa ni// 'jig rten mtshams las 'das pa yi// don gang 'ud kyis bkod gyur pa// de yis mkhas rnams yid tshims par// byed 'gyur zhes ni smra bar byed// dbye na sngon byung gtam dang ni// bsngags par 'os pa la sbyar ba'o// dper brjod rim bzhin bshad bya ba// deng nas bzung ste bdag gi khyim// lha yi khyim bzhin bsten par 'os// khyod kyi zhabs rdul lhung ba yis// nyes pa dag ni ma lus bkrus// khyod kyi nu ma 'di lta bur// rnam par rgyas par 'gyur ba 'di// byed pos nges par ma brtags par// sa gzhi dag ni chung ngur byas// phyi nas gnas der ma shong bar// gong nas gong du rtsegs par gyur// de ltar 'jig rten mtshams las ni// brgal dang ma brgal rgyan sbyar ba// lho dang shar gyi snyan dngags kyi// lam gyi srol du bshad pa yin// bcu pa ting 'dzin zhes bya ba'i// snyan dngags mtshan nyid dbye ba dang*// dper brjod dag gis bstan par bya// 'jig rten gzhung gi rjes 'brangs nas// mig dang bud med lta bu yi// khyad par ku mud ta sogs la// sbyar ba de yi mtshan nyid do// dbye na chos gcig bkod pa dang*// chos mang bkod pa'i ting 'dzin no// dang po mig gi sgra bkod dang*// gnyis pa skyugs pa'i sgras bstan pa'o// de dag rim bzhin bshad bya ba// 'jig rten na ni ku mud ta// kha 'byed zum pa zhes grags kyi// mig 'byed zum par ma grags kyang*// snyan dngags mkhan gyis rgyan btags pas// phyi nas de ltar grags thob 'gyur// skyugs pa zhes bya 'jig rten na// mi gtsang khyad par 'ga' la grags// phyi nas snyan dngags mkhan gyis ni// nyi mas 'od zer skyugs pa zhes// sbyar na kun la grags par 'gyur// nyi ma'i 'od zer shar ba na// ku mutta ni mig zum zhing*// pad mo'i tshogs rnams mig bye nas// ge sar 'dzum zhing rgod pa la// bung ba gzhon nus lce rtse rkyong*// nyi zer skyugs pa padma yis// 'thungs nas rdul dmar skyugs pa yi// kha yi dag byed zer ma rnams// shin tu skyug par byed pa bzhin// zhes pa mdzes so mi mdzes pa// chung ma skyug par byed ces pa'o// chos mang bkod pa'i ting 'dzin la// mtshan nyid dpe dang don bshad pa// rim pa bzhin du bstan par bya// chos can gzhan gyi chos du ma// gzhan la cig car bkod pa'i dpe// lci ba'i mngal khur gyis ngal zhing*// 'khun par byed pa'i sprin gyi phreng*// 'di dag g.yo med steng gi ni// phang pa dag tu yang dag nyal// grogs mo'i phang par nyal ba dang*// 'khun dang lci ba nyid dang ngal// zhes pa 'dir ni mngal ldan ma'i// chos mang po rnams gzhan la bstan// ting 'dzin zhes bya'i rgyan gcig 'di// snyan dngags bdog rgyu bsdus pa'i nor// snyan dngags mkhan po don mthun gyi// tshong pa'i tshogs rnams 'di nyid len// de ltar snyan dngags lugs gnyis kyi// tshul la brtags nas de ltar phye// dpa' bo nag mo'i 'khol la sogs// snyan dngags mkhan po so so yi// khyad par mtha' dag brjod pa na// dbyangs can ma yang ngal bar byed// bur shing 'o ma bur sogs kyi// mngar ba'i khyad par su yis brjod// rang bzhin gyis grub spobs pa dang*// mang du thos pa dri med dang*// mngon par sbyor ba mi dman pa// snyan dngags phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu// nam yang mkhas pa'i gral mgor 'dug 'dod dang*// snyan grags gtam gyis nges par mtho 'dod na// snyom las spangs te dbyangs can snyan dngags kyi// rgyud mang 'khrol ba 'di ni nges par longs// snyan dngags kyi me long rnam par bshad pa dbyangs can gyi rol mtsho las/

rnam par phye ba'i le'u rgyas par bshad pa ste le'u dang po'o// //gang gang 'bad pas gang sbyar ba// de de'i gzhung la ma brtags par// mkhas mkhas 'dod nas mkhas rlom gyis// 'grig 'grig bsgrigs nas sbyar ba min// 'di nyid bklags pa tsam gyis kyang*// me long zhes bya'i snyan dngags kyi// tshig dang don rnams gegs med par// ji bzhin 'char ba'i rol mtsho'o// // ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shā sa na ka bya ā darsha wa ta ra mā khā nā ma/ bod skad du/ snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos me long la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba/ 'jam dbyangs dbyangs kyi phreng ba rna bar snyan// snyan grags grags pa'i 'dzum zer kun gyi rgyan// rgyan phreng phreng ba spel mkhas mchog gi lha// lha dbang dbang po'i nyer mtshos g.yo med mdzod// rig byed dran pa'i gdong gi padma yi// chu gter mdzes pa'i zhal ldan dbyangs can ma// tha snyad gzhung brgya'i de nyid stsol mkhas khyod// snying gi rol mtshor rtag par gnas byos shig /mngon brjod sdeb sbyor lang tsho ldan gyur kyang*// gzhan yid 'phrog pa'i rgyan dang mi ldan na// snyan dngags sgeg mo mkhas pas len mi 'gyur// de phyir yid 'ongs rgyan gyi phreng ba spel// don gyi rgyan dang sgra rgyan dang*// gab tshig rgyan ces bya ba gsum// dang po sum cu rtsa lnga po// rang bzhin brjod dang dpe dang ni// gzugs can gsal byed skor ba dang*// 'gog dang don gzhan bkod pa dang*// ldog pa can dang srid pa dang*// bsdus dang phul byung rab brtags dang*// rgyu dang phra mo cha dang rim// dga' dang nyams ldan gzi brjid dang*// rnam grangs brjod dang kun tu phan// rgya che smyon dor sbyar ba dang*// khyad par mtshungs par sbyor ba dang*// 'gal dang skabs min bstod pa dang*// dang*// yon tan dang ni rdzas brjod pa'i// dbye bas rnam pa bzhi yin no// khyod zhabs sgeg mo'i stabs kyis bzhugs// nyid zhal 'dzum gyi mnga' mdangs gang*// gang gsung rna bar snyan cing 'jebs// dbyangs dag len// zhes pa bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod// dbyangs can zhal gyi 'dzum phreng gis// lus la bde ba rgyas pa dang*// yid la dga' bas gang ba dang*// bstan bcos rtsom pa thogs med byed// ces pa yon tan rang bzhin brjod// sor gdub rgyan phreng g.yo ldan pa'i// phyag nyid sor mo'i 'degs 'jog gis// dri za'i rgyud mangs dang 'grogs pa'i// snyan dngags phreng ba sgyur de 'khrungs// zhes pa rdzas kyi rang bzhin brjod// yang na mā li ka phreng ni// mgul bar 'phyang zhing zla ba yi// 'od zer cod paṇa rtse la 'dzin// dri za'i na chung dbus na mdzes// ji ltar ji bzhin de 'dra sogs// tshig gis zin pa dpe yi rgyan// khyod sku zla ba ji bzhin dkar// khyod gsung dri za'i dbyangs bzhin snyan// nyid thugs rgya mtsho ji bzhin zab// kun mkhyen ji bzhin dbyangs can mkhas// zhes pa chos dang dpe dag ni// mthun tshul dngos su bstan pa'i dpe// khyod gsung dri za'i dbyangs ji bzhin// gang thugs yid bzhin rgya mtsho bzhin// dbyangs can ma de kun mkhyen 'dra// zhes pa mthun tshul shugs la mtshon// khyod zhal ji bzhin padma yi// 'dab phreng yid 'ongs rnam par rgyas// khyod gsung ji bzhin dri za yi// dbyangs de rnam par 'jen cing gshin// zhes pa grags pa bzlog pa'i dpe// khyod zhal ji bzhin zla ba dkar// zla ba ji bzhin khyod zhal mdzes// khyod thugs kun la snyoms pa bzhin// nyin mor byed pa 'gro kun la// zhes pa phan tshun brjod pa'i dpe// khyod sku'i dkar ba padma dang*// mtshungs kyi gzhan ni su dang min// thugs rje'i 'dzum zer zla ba dang*// 'dra yi gzhan dang mtshungs pa med// ces pa nges pa'i dper brjod do// zla ba la yang khyod sku dang*// mtshungs pa'i dkar bsil de yod dam// dri za'i dbyangs la'ang khyod gsung gi

/snyan pa yod na de 'dra'o// zhes 'di nges pa med pa'i dpe// khyod sku mdzes pa kho na yis// zla ba'i dpe zlar byas pa min// sim zhing reg na bde ba dang*// yid la dga' ba ster bas kyang*// zhes 'di bsdus pa'i dper brjod do// khyod zhal yid 'phrog khyod nyid la// zla ba'i 'dzum zer mkha' nyid la// de bas 'di gnyis tha dad de// gzhan med ces pa phul byung dpe// 'dzum mdangs sgeg pa'i nyams kyis ni// dbyangs can dpal mo snyems mi 'tshal// dkar bsil mdangs gsal nam mkha' yi// bu mo la yang nyams 'di yod// ces pa 'di ni rab brtags dpe// yid 'ongs gdong mdzes padma 'ga'// 'dab phreng ring po'i smin legs dang*// ge sar 'dzum gyis gzhan 'gugs na// dbyangs can bzhin gyi pad phreng 'dzin// zhes pa rmad du byung ba'i dpe// rab mdzes khyod zhal zla ba zhes// yid bsdus bram zes phyag kyang byas// ri bong 'dzin pa'i mnga' mdangs la// khyod kyi zhal du mngon par bsam// zhes pa 'di ni rmongs pa'i dpe// shar gyi ri bo'i phrag pa na// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shar ram ci// dbyangs can mgrin pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser// zhal mdangs cha shas rdzogs sam ci// zhes pa 'di ni the tshom dpe// nyi ma 'bum gyi zer 'phrog cing*// yid kyi shing rta g.yo ldan pa'i// khyod zhal ngo mtshar nyin byed kyis// pham byed zla ba ga la yin// zhes pa the tshom bzlog pa'i dpe// padma'i lte bar gnas pa dang*// zla ba'i cod paṇa mdzes pa dang*// rtag tu rig byed 'don mkhas pas// khyod ni khyod kyi yab dang mtshungs// zhes pa sbyar ba'i dper brjod do// bzhin gyi phreng ba spel legs shing*// reg 'jam dri zhim 'thul ba dang*// rtag tu 'dod pas myos byed pa'i// ldum ra'i utpal bu mo bzhin// zhes pa 'di ni mnyam nyid dpe// lang tsho'i yar ngo mi nyams shing*// nyin yang 'od dkar 'phro mkhas ma// khyod kyi zhal ni zla ba dang*// mtshungs pa bas kyang ches cher lhag

/ces pa smad pa'i dpe yin no// pad dkar phreng ba 'dod ldan ma// kun gyi zur phud rtse la 'dzegs// zla 'od bde byung ral pa yi// padma'i rgya mtshor rtag par gnas// de phyir khyod zhal pad dkar dang*// zla ba'i 'od dang mtshungs so zhes// brjod pa bsngags pa'i dpe yin no// mtshungs pa dang ni mi mtshungs pa'i// cha shas rnam pa mang gyur kyang*// khyod zhal zla ba mtshungs so zhes// brjod 'dod snyan dngags mkhan gyi blo// khyod zhal zla ba'i mdzes pa 'phrog /zla bas padma'i bzhin ras sdud// 'dab brgya pa dang ston zla dang*// khyod zhal gsum po 'gal bar nges// zhes pa 'gal ba'i dper brjod do// yid la nam yang mi 'jug cing*// lan brgyar gsal yang snyan dngags kyi// utpal phreng ba mi ster ba// mtshan mo'i bu mos dbyangs can la// 'gran pa'i go skabs ga la mchis// zhes pa dgag pa'i dpe nyid do// khyod kyi zhal nas utpal gyi// dri bsung 'dra ba kho na bro// utpal la ni utpal gyi// dri nyid mnam mod khyod rang lhag /ces pa ngo bstod dpe nyid do// khyod zhal nyid yin pad dkar min// mtshems dkar gzhon nu ge sar min// 'phrul ldan spyan zung bung ba min// zhal gyi bcud gang sbrang rtsi min// zhes pa de nyid brjod pa'i dpe// zla bas padma'i mdzes pa 'phrog /zla bzhin ma des zla ba yi// khengs pa 'phrog byed khyod zhal gyi// khyod rang nyid dang mtshungs pa yin// zhes pa thun mong min pa'i dpe// gsum rtsen pad mo'i mdzes sdug kun// gcig tu byas pa'i yid 'dzin nam// lha min bu mo'i mdzes sdug ni// gcig tu byas pa dbyangs can zhal// zhes pa byung min dpe yin no// chu shel las ni me lce dang*// lha min dpal las bdud rtsi dang*// mi mkhas rnams las legs bshad ltar// dbyangs can zhal sgor mi snyan gsung*// zhes pa srid pa min pa'i dpe// chu gter las ni chu klung dang*// tsandan las ni bsil ba dang*// nyi ma'i kho nas 'od zer ltar// dbyangs can zhal nas ngo mtshar gtam// zhes pa khyad par mang ba'i dpe// dbyangs can legs bshad chu gter gyi// mgrin pa'i mdzod nas phyung ba bzhin// bzhin mdzes zla ba 'gram pa dang*// padma'i khong nas bton pa bzhin// zhes pa 'di ni rnam 'gyur dpe// 'od dkar phreng bas zla ba'i gdong*// zla bas bde 'byung thor cog rtse// de yis drag po brjid chags bzhin// legs bshad gtam gyis dbyangs can gsung*// gsung de lha mo'i zhal gyi sgo// zhal des srid pa gsum mnan pa'i// phun tshogs de ni khyod la mnga'// zhes pa de ni phreng ba'i dpe// khyod zhal mgrin pa dul gug cing*// mtshems kyi phreng ba dkar ldan nang*// bung ba g.yo ldan 'dab brgya'i phreng*// ge sar 'dzum gyis mtshon pa bzhin// lus phra padma'i 'chu ba bzhin// gdong mdzes padma'i bzhin ras bzhin// bung ba ji bzhin kho bo'i mig

/khyod zhal bdud rtsi 'thung zhing rtse// zhes pa ngag don nyer 'jal des// bzhin sgra gcig dang mang po gnyis// go rim bzhin du bstan de'o// snyan dngags shes pa mang mod kyang*// dbyangs can khyod 'dra gnyis pa med// rnam rgyal khang bzangs khri la ni// brgya byin gnyis pa yod dam ci// zhes pa zla bo'i dngos po'i dpe// gzhu rgyal dgra bos gsum rtsen yul// sa skyong 'dzin ma'i khyon 'di bsdud// sogs mtshon// khyod zhal 'dzum gyi utpal phreng*// legs bshad mgrin pa'i dar dir ni// spyan zung bung ba'i 'phur lding dang*// lhan cig rgyu ba 'di ya mtshan// zhes pa ldan pa'i gzugs can no// rgyal ba khyod zhal nyi ma ni// 'dzum zer zla ris 'bum phrag dang*// spyan zur ku mud g.yo ldan pas// 'gro ba kun la rtag par gzigs// zhes 'di ldan min gzugs can no// rgyal ba khyod zhal zla ba ni// smin legs ri bong mdzes gyur cing*// mchu sgros bim pa'i tshon ris kyis// yid kyi srubs shing lhag par rgyas// zhes pa mi mnyam pa'i gzugs can// yan lag can la gzugs bkod cing*// yan lag la lar gzugs bkod /bde 'byung ral pa'i gos 'chang ba// brgya byin gtsug tu 'phos pa na// rnam rgyal lha yi rgyal mtshan g.yo// smin legs drug ldan khyab 'jug gi /rkang pa'i gos kyi rtser mchod pas// khrung khrung dogs med ri khrod ma'i// dga' ston rgyal mtshan rgyal gyur cig /ces pa rgyal mtshan tog gi ni// khyad par rkang pa la bkod pa// de phyir khyad par dang bcas pa'i// gzugs can dper brjod nyams dga' ba// shar ri'i phrag pa mi 'gong zhing*// nub kyi ri bo mi gnon la// zhe sdang ku mud zum byed pa'i// khyod zhal zla ba 'di ngo mtshar// zhes pa 'gal ba'i gzugs can no// dbu dpangs mtho bas lhun po der// mkhyen yangs zab pa rgya mtsho'i klong*// 'jig rten gsum gyi re ba ni// skong phyir yid bzhin rin chen no// zhes pa rgyu yi gzugs can no// bcom ldan khyod drung pad mtshor ni// ngang pa'i sde dpon lding bar 'os// dbyangs can bung ba stong phrag gi /kun dga'i dpal du de 'gyur ro// zhes pa sbyar ba'i gzugs can no// brgya byin thod kyi phrag pa la// rab zhon sen mo'i dmar 'od ni// 'char kha'i tshon gyis rab 'khyud pa'i// nyi ma'i mdangs la 'gran par nges// zhes pa mthun pa'i gzugs can no// padma'i mdza' bo rta bdun zhon// nyid zhal lha brgya'i ral pa la// nyin byed nub ri'i phreng ba nyal// khyod zhabs gzims pa ga la mnga'// zhes pa bzlog pa'i gzugs can no// khyod kyi zhabs sen nyi ma ni// lha brgya'i gtsug na sil yab mkhan// 'khor ba'i me chen zhi mdzad pas// nyi ma'i dngos po min par nges// zhes pa 'gog pa'i gzugs can no// khyed kyi mkhyen brtse'i zhugs gcig gis// bdag blo'i dri ma kun 'khrud pa// mkhyen brtse'i skyon nam bdag blo yi// nyes pa'i yon tan las ma 'das// zhes pa mnyam 'jog gzugs can no// khyod zhabs padma'i dpag bsam la// mig gi bung ba 'khril shing ni// rgyang nas 'phur zhing 'khril ba 'di// bung ba gzhon nu'i sgeg 'chang ma// zhes pa gzugs can gyi gzugs can// khyod zhal ma lags 'dzum gyi utpal steng*// khyod gsung ma lags mes po'i dbyangs kyi rnga// khyod thugs ma lags bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor nges// khyod mthu ma lags byed po skyengs byed yin// zhes pa smyon dor gzugs can no// gzugs can nyi shu'i khri steng na// snyan dngags nyams kyi mdangs gsal ba'i// rtag tu dam pa'i chos gsung ba// khyod la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rigs dang bya ba yon tan dang*// rdzas tshig gcig na gnas pa yis// gal te ngag kun la phan na// gsal byed rgyan du bshad pa yin// dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgyun gcig gis// sdug bsngal tshad pa kun bsil byed// zhe sdang sreg za'i tshogs chen dang*// chags pa'i me chen 'bar ba yang*// mi shes byin za'i dpung bcas las// sgrol lo 'gro ba ma lus pa// sdug bsngal chu gter bzhi po las// zhi bar zhugs rnams rang don gyi// dgon pa'i nags tshal stug po las// rgyal lo khyod kyi blo gros ni// mtha' med shes bya'i phyogs rnams dang*// ma rung bdud sde bzhi po dang*// dman pa'i sa gnyis dag las kyang*// rgyal bas mi shes mun pa'i tshogs// gang du bzhag cing stobs sogs kyi// yid 'ongs chos rnams gang nas blangs// yon tan rnams la skyon btsal lam// zhes pa rigs dang bya ba dang*// yon tan dang ni rdzas brjod pa'i// thog ma'i gsal byed yin no kye// bya rgod spungs pa'i skyed tshal du// chos kyi rnga dbyangs len pa dang*// lha yul 'og min nyams dga' bar// theg chen chos kyi rnga brdung ba'i// rgyal ba khyod ni grong du'ang gshegs// zhes pa rigs kyi gsal byed ni// bar na yod pa zhes bya'o// 'byor ldan khyod kyi bde ba dang*// gzhan gyi sdug bsngal brje bar mdzad// phongs rnams rang gi nor min dang*// gzhan nor khyad par can rnams so// zhes pa bya ba'i gsal byed ni// bar na yod pa zhes bya'o// pha rol mi bsrun dgra bo yis// khros dang chags pa'i mtshon cha dang*// phrag dog dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi// rgyal ba khyod kyi thugs rje'i dpung*// zhes pa rigs kyi gsal byed ni// mtha' na yod pa zhes bya'o// khyod kyis byang chub brnyes pa dang*// me tog gzhu can nyal ba dang*// zhabs sen mes po'i spyi gtsug tu// blangs pa gsum po mnyam du byung*// zhes pa bya ba'i gsal byed ni// mtha' na yod pa zhes bya'o// 'phel bar mdzad do bcom ldan gyis// bstan pa'o des kyang bstan 'dzin no// de yis phan dang bde ba dang*// des kyang mtho ris byang grol lo// zhes pa phreng ba'i gsal byed yin// rgyal ba khyod kyi phrin las kyis// 'dod lha'i yid kyi bud shing bsreg

/gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dri ma 'khrud// chos kyi rnga dbyangs gcig gis kyang*// me tog gzhu can yid dang ni// gzhan gyi yid la myos pa dang*// sangs pa gnyis po spel bar bya// zhes pa byed po las gcig gis// bya ba 'gal ba gnyis mtshon pa// 'gal ba'i don gyi gsal byed do// mkhyen pa'i nyi ma gcig shar bas// rmongs pa'i mun chen bsal ba dang*// bdud sde'i bya rnams long ba dang*// phan bde'i padmo rgyas par byas// zhes pa don gcig gsal ba'i dpe// stong gsum zhing la dbang sgyur zhing*// lha rnams kun gyis phyag byas pa// thub pa rgyal byed tshal na ste// tshangs pa tshangs pa'i 'jig rten na// zhes pa sbyar ba'i gsal byed do// snyan dngags nyams kyi khrir bzhugs nas// gsal byed drug gi lang tsho can// bcom ldan tshig rgyan mkhan khyod la// rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gsal byed kyi ni gnas nyid du// don bskor ba dang tshig bskor dang*// gnyis ka bskor ba zhes bya yi// rgyan gyi phreng ba gsum du 'dod// sa skyong rgyal po mngon par mtho// phyug po rnams ni mang pos bkur// mkhas pa rnams ni kun las 'phags// g.yul ngor dpa' ba gzhan las rgyal// zhes pa khyad gzhi so so la// khyad chos don gcig rnam grangs pa// sbyar ba don rnams bskor ba'i rgyan// lus med kyis 'phangs me tog mdas// lang tsho can gyi yid g.yo byed// mkhas pa'i legs bshad mda' gcig gis// blo gsal mang po'i yid rab g.yo// zhes pa khyad gzhi so so la// khyad chos tshig gcig sbyar bas na// tshig gis bskor ba can zhes bya// thugs kyi rgya mtsho snying rje yi// chu bo gcig pos rtag tu 'dud// mkhyen pa'i chu gter legs bshad kyi// chu bo bzhi pos rtag tu khengs// lus med zhags pas ma bcings kyang*// lus can kun la lhag par chags// me tog gzhu can las rgyal yang*// lang tsho can la rtag par brtse// zhes pa tshig dang don gnyis ka

/sbyar ba'i dpe zhes mkhas la grags// dgag bya 'gog pa'i rgyan zhes pa'i// rnam par dbye ba de bshad bya// thugs rje'i lcags kyu gcig gis kyang*// kun gyi bla nas bzung ngo zhes// sngon chad grags pa de mi srid// 'on kyang nus pa bsam mi khyab// ces pa 'das pa 'gog pa'i dpe// bcom ldan lha yi rnga dbyangs kyis// dam chos 'chad pa'i ngal bas ci// khyod zhal mthong ba'i mod nyid nas// khro dang chags pa'i 'ching las grol// zhes pa da ltar 'gog pa'i dpe// bcom ldan chos dbyings zhi ba'i nags// rab tu dben pa der gzims nas// 'gro 'di yal bar dor gyi dogs// thugs rje'i spyan gyis ring gzigs shig /ces pa ma 'ongs 'gog pa'i rgyan// rgyal ba khyod la 'gro ba kun// chags pa'i zhal mdzes mnga' ba rdzun// bden na yid kyi srub shing ni// khyod kyi zhal la sdang ba ci// zhes pa khyad chos 'gog pa'i dpe// nyin mor byed pa'i 'od tsam dang*// lang tsho can gyi mdzes sdug bzhin// rgyal ba khyod kyi mtshan dpe tsam// mthong gi nyid sku dngos su min// zhes pa'am yang na 'di lta ste// sum rtsen mdzes sdug ri mo ni// khyod zhal me long la 'phos pa'i// sgrib byed gsar pa 'dis bsgribs nas// nyid zhal gang yin mthong ma nus// zhes pa chos can 'gog pa'i rgyan// brtse chen khyod thugs 'khrugs pa yi// chu 'dzin gsar pa'i rlabs 'phro zhing*// skyon zhal 'brug gi sgra sgrogs kyang*// nyes pa med pas bdag mi 'jigs// zhes pa'am yang na 'di lta ste// zhal mdangs gsal bar mi ston cing*// 'jam pa'i phyag ring mi rkyong yang*// khyod la khro ba mi mnga' ba'i// rgyu des kho bo 'dir mi snyems// zhes pa rgyu 'gog pa yi dpe// bcom ldan zhi ba'i rgya mtshor bzhud// nags kyi khu byug skyo dbyangs len// ston gyi sir bu ngad ldang yang*// lha yul dben par mi 'gro ci// zhes pa 'bras bu 'gog pa'i rgyan// mgon khyod chos dbyings mdzes ma yi// nags der gshegs na myur du gshegs// bdag cag mthar byed bdag po yi// grong de khyod la rjes mi chags// zhes pa rjes gnang 'gog pa'o// khyod sku 'og min pho brang der// myur bar gshegs na zag med kyi// bde ba mchog der dgyes par rol// bdag cag 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor dga'// zhes pa dbang gis 'gog pa'o// 'gro kun bde ba dge yin te// mgon gcig bde ba dge ma yin// rgyal ba gshegs sam bzhugs gyur kyang*// gnas skabs de 'drar 'gyur ba lags// zhes pa ma gus 'gog pa'i rgyan// rgyal ba gshegs na dge bar gshegs// gshegs pa'i bshul ring bde gyur cig

/bdag cag 'dod pa'i sar gnas pa// kun kyang 'og min der rjes 'brang*// zhes pa shis brjod sgo nas 'gog /bcom ldan zhing gzhan la dgyes pa// nyid kyi gdul bya gzhan 'ga' tshol// bdag cag nyon mongs kyis gdungs pa// 'di dag ngan song nags su 'gro// zhes pa rtsub mo'i 'gog pa'i dpe// rgyal ba zhing gzhan lha yul du// myur bar gshegs shig dal gyur na// mi rnams khyod dang bral ba yi// mya ngan zhags pas khyod zhabs 'ching*// zhes pa 'grogs byas sgo nas 'gog /khyed kyi bzhed dang rjes mthun pas// gshegs zhes 'jeb par gsol 'dod kyang*// rang gi 'dod pas tshig 'khrul nas// ma gshegs zhes 'dir khyod bzod cig /ces pa 'bad pas 'gog pa'i rgyan// rgyal ba zhing gzhan gshegs rtsom ni// rang gi thugs rje nyid la dris// bdag cag khyod kyi snying rje yi// ra ba'i mtshams las 'da' mi byed// ces pa gzhan dbang gis 'gog rgyan// rgyal ba khyod kyis bdag la ni// nyid kyis brnyes pa'i go 'phang de// de ring gnas 'dir byin cig dang*// mgon khyod gshegs la bzod par gyis// zhes pa thabs kyis 'gog pa'o// zhal gyi gzhu las gshegs zhes pa'i// rtsub mo'i tshig mdas bdag la bsdun// da ni gshegs par ma gyur kyang*// bdag cag gson pa'i go skabs med// ces pa khro bas 'gog pa'o// khyod ni zhing gzhan gshegs gyur na// bung bas bdud rtsi ma 'thung zhing*// rgyan du ma byas padma ni// dgra yi rdzing du lhung ba bzhin// zhes pa mya ngan gyis 'gog pa'o// khyod zhal mdzes pa ma bltas shing*// khyod gsung snyan pa'ang ma thos par// na tshod mtha' dag song gyur pas// khyod kyi gshegs rtsom de ring gshol// zhes pa 'gyod pas 'gog pa'i dpe// gser gyi lhun po khrir 'khod dam// yang na bcom ldan thub pa nyid// gsung 'di tshangs pa'i dbyangs 'dra bas// brjid chags gang de lhun po min// zhes 'di the tshom 'gog pa'i dpe// zhal dkar bdud rtsi spro byed cing*// chos min padma la sdang ba'i// khyod zhal zla ba 'di yod bzhin// ri bong 'dzin pas ci zhig bya// zhes pa sbyar bas 'gog pa'i dpe// khyod kyis dregs pa can gzhan kun// mnan kyang tshim pa med pa ci// 'on kyang rgya mtsho gting zab ni// chu yis ngoms pa med par mthong*// zhes pa don gzhan 'gog pa'i dpe// phongs pa rnams kyis khyod la ni// sbyin pa po zhes mi bstod de// slong mo pa rnams rang gi nor// len par bsams nas bde bar spyod// ces pa rgyu yis 'gog pa'i dpe// thugs rje che ldan rgyal ba la// 'gog rgyan nyi shu rtsa gsum gyis// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol ba'i// dge des 'chi med la reg shog

/'dod pa'i dngos po 'ga' bzhag nas// de yi sgrub byed gzhan bkod pa// don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan yin brgyad// thugs rje che ldan rgyal ba nyid// gshegs pa rtsom pa su zhig rgol// phyi nang dngos po'i rang bzhin ni// nges par 'jig la su yis 'gongs// zhes pa kun khyab don gzhan bkod// gtong yod can la ma blangs kyang*// rang gi bdog kun gzhan la ster// chen po rnams ni ma 'dris kyang*// mi bsrun pa la bag 'bebs byed// ces pa khyad par la gnas pa'i// don gzhan bkod pa zhes bya ba// kun la bzod pas sran thub na// 'jig rten pa kun dga' ba bskyed// lang tsho ldan pa'i mdzes sdug gis// kun gyi yid 'dzin byed min nam// zhes pa sbyar ba'i don gzhan bkod// legs bshad ldan pa khros gyur kyang*// shes rab can gyi yid 'phrog byed// gnyis skyes dbang phyug dri ma dang*// ldan yang dkar ba'i cha mi sgrib// ces pa 'gal ba'i don gzhan bkod// 'dod ldan rnams la zhi ba'i nags// snying gi sdug bsngal spel ba'i rgyu// 'do dkar ldan pa'i bsil zer gyis// 'ga' la tshad pa'i nad dag bskyed// ces pa mi 'os don gzhan bkod// 'dod pa'i yon tan dga' ma yis// pha rol sems kyi bud shing bsreg /'dod pa'i me de sreg za dang*// sreg par mtshungs pa 'di rigs so// zhes pa 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod// 'dod pa'i yon tan la sred na// rang snying gdung ba 'di bden mod// zhi ba'i dgon pa la chags pas// gdung ba bskyed pa 'di ya mtshan// zhes pa 'os shing mi 'os pa'i// don gzhan bkod pa zhes bya'o// dngos po med la chags pa yis// 'ching na dngos po smos ci dgos// zla ba'i 'od kyis sreg byed na// padmo'i gnyen gyis lta ci smos// zhes pa 'os shing mi 'os pa'i// don gzhan bkod pa zhes bya ba// rnam pa brgyad po de bshad do// mtshungs pa'i dngos po gnyis bshad na// de yi khyad par shan 'byed pa// ldog pa can gyi rgyan zhes brjod// khyod dang rgya mtsho zab cing yangs// 'du 'god mang pos 'phel 'grib med// khyod zhal yangs pa'i nyi ma las// gsung gi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro// zhes pa gcig gi ldog pa can// rin chen 'byung gnas dag la khyod// mtshams las mi 'da' lhun cing sdug

/rgya mtsho dma' ba'i gzhi la 'khyil// khyod kyis mthon po'i go 'phang bzung*// zhes pa gnyis ka'i ldog pa can// khyod dang nyi ma mthong ba dang*// blang dor gsal bar ston pas mtshungs// 'char nub res kyis 'jog pa dang*// 'char nub med pas khyod gnyis 'gal// zhes pa sbyar ba'i ldog pa can// rtag tu phan par sems pa dang*// 'od stong 'byung gnas yin mod kyang*// bcu gnyis khyim las mi 'da' ba'i// nyi ma khyod kyi zla bo min// zhes pa 'gog pa can zhes pa'i// ldog pa can gyi dpe yin drang*// shing rta'i khri la rab 'dug cing*// mang po'i dkyil na brjid chags kyang*// 'ga' zhig tsha bas gdungs pa'i phyir// rta ljang can de khyod las dman// zhes pa gtan tshigs bkod pa yi// ldog pa can gyi dpe yin no// sngar bshad de dag sgra zin gyi// ldog pa can gyi dper bshad la// don gyis go ba'i ldog pa can// gzhan gyi dpe yang bshad bya ba// khyod kyi zhal dang nyi ma yi// khyad par nyi ma mkha' la gnas// khyod zhal khyod kyi gdong pa las// gzhan du 'pho ba ga la srid// nyi ma la ni mthon mthing mig /smin legs ri mos mtshan pa med// khyod gdong mdzes byed mig gnyis po// smin ma'i me tog mdangs kyis mtshon// sngar bshad de dag 'byed byed chos// mi mtshungs pa yi ldog pa can// de nas 'byed byed mtshungs pa yi// mtshungs tshul don gyis go bar bshad// khyod kyi zhal dang nyi ma gsal// mnga' mdangs gang zhig 'od zer 'phro// nyi ma bcu gnyis khyim du 'pho// khyod kyis sa chen bcu gnyis bgrod// rab dkar ngang mo chu yi rgyan// khyod zhal dkar ba 'jig rten rgyan// nyi ma'i 'od kyis mun sel zhing*// blta bya'i gnas la sgrib byed pa'i// 'gro ba'i yid kyi mun pa ni// mkhyen pa'i snang ba gcig gis sel// zhes pa rigs mthun ldog pa can// bcu dgu rnam par bshad zin to// rab tu grags pa'i rgyu bzlog nas// rgyu gzhan shugs la rab ston pa// de ni srid pa can zhes bya// ma bkug 'khyog pa dbang po'i gzhu// rma med 'bigs pa tshig gi mda'// ma grungs dwangs pa rang gi sems// 'di gsum dbyar gyi dga' ston yin// ma bris mtshan dpe'i ri mo gsal// ma bteg gtsug tor kun las mtho// ma bshams g.yul las rgyal ba ni// rgyal ba khyod kyi ya mtshan no// dngos po 'ga' la bsam byas nas// de dang mtshungs pa'i dngos po gzhan// brjod pa bsdus pa can zhes bya// 'gro rnams gnyid las sad pa dang*// ma bskul nyi ma ngang gis 'char// 'gro rnams gnyid kyis myos pa dang*// nyi mas rang gi mal stan 'dzin// nags kyi khu byug snyan sgrogs mod// khyim bya rang gi stegs nas zer// ngang pa'i rgyal po bzhin bzang de// 'o ma'i chu gter dbus na rtse// dregs 'dod chu skyar gzhon nu yang*// lteng ka'i dbus na rgyal po bzhin// bdud rtsi 'dzin pa'i lang tsho can// dar la bab pa'i padmar rol// res 'ga' dza ti'i me tog kyang*// don 'di gang la bsam pa soms// de yi dbye ba dper brjod na// khyad par can tsam tha dad kyang*// khyad chos rnam pa mtshungs pa ni// rtsa ba rab brtan 'bras bu yi// khur gyis phongs pa'i re skong zhing*// kun kyang dga' ba nyer spel ba// dpag bsam ljon pa 'di ya mtshan// khyad gzhi tha dad khyad par chos// 'ga' zhig tha dad 'ga' zhig ni// tha mi dad pa'i dpe bshad pa// rgya khyon khor yug rab yangs shing*// rnam bkra'i me tog phreng mdzes g.yo// phyogs rnams kun nas yid 'ongs pa// gri bsil g.yo ldan 'di ngo mtshar// chu srin tshogs kyis ma gang zhing*// rta gdong me yis ma mnan pa'i// rang bzhin bzang po'i chu gter ni// gong nas gong du 'phel ba yis// zhes pa sngon med bsdus pa can// 'jig rten mtshams las rgal gyur pa'i// rgyan gang brjod 'dod kyis sbyar ba// phul byung rgyan gyi dam pa yin// dngul dkar gsal ba'i me long can// ga bur gzhon nu'i gos gyon zhing*// tsandan byug spos kyis bsil ba'i// khengs ldan ma 'di zla ba'i 'od// ma yin rab dkar ngang mo ni// anda rnyil gyi mtshor zhugs pa// zhes pa yin no dbye ba ni// tshang ra gser gyi stegs bu dang*// rab gang nu ma'i dngul bum gyi// bar na sked pa'i chu skyes ni// yod dam med ces the tshom can// zhes pa the tshom phul byung dpe// nyi ma'i 'od kyis nam mkha' yi// khor yug rgal kyang sa chen gyi// khyon las gzhan du mi 'da' ba// e ma sa 'di shin tu yangs// zhes pa grags pa'i phul byung dpe// de las gzhan yang bshad bya ba// lce brgya ldan pa'i chu 'dzin gyis// grags pa'i thigs pa nyer blangs shing*// phrin las chu bo brgya phab kyang*// yon tan chu gter mi zad pa// byed pos gsar du bskrun min nam// rnyed bkur khri la rab 'khod nas// grags pa'i gdugs dkar g.yo ldan zhing*/

bstod pa'i bsil yab stob mkhas pas// mngon bsngags bsngags kyang mi sred pa// lus med dpung gis phyag byas sam// thos pa'i bzhin mdzes g.yo ldan zhing*// rnam dpyod lang tsho'i ljon pa la// grags pa'i 'khri shing gis 'khril kyang*// 'dod pa'i chang gis mi myos pa// nyag phran bdag po las rgyal lam// snyan grags chu bo brgya phrag gi /zhags pas phyogs brgyar drang bsrangs kyang*// gting zab blo gros mi sgul ba// 'di ni khyod blo'i rgya mtsho min// rab brtan gser gyi lhun po yin// rnyed bkur zhags pas ma bcings shing*// chos brgyad stan la mi 'dug par// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mal stan las// rnam pa gzhan du mi g.yo ba// gsung rab chang gis myos sam ci// gang de dngos po'i gnas tshul las// rnam pa gzhan du rtog byed pa// de ni rab rtogs ces pa'i rgyan// bde 'byung gtsug rgyan shar ba na// 'dab brgya mi bzhad ngo zum pa// nyi mas zla ba'i cha shas ni// bcom pa'i 'khon lan nyi ma'i gnyen// pad dkar de la bslan par nges// nyi ma shar tshe ku mu ta// ngo 'dzum gnag pa rgyu ci zhig /ku mud gnyen gyi cha shas dag /nyi mas bcom pa'i 'khon lan yin// tshes kyi bzhin mdzes shar ba na// nyi ma mal du nyal ba ci// yar ngo'i tshes la bzhin bzangs mas// nyi ma'i dpag bsam la 'khril nas// 'dod pa'i khyim du nyal des lan// dpyid dus nyi zer 'bar ba na// rgya mtsho lhag par 'phel ba ci// nyi ma'i 'od kyis nam mkha' yi// dbang sngon zhu ba 'khyil bar nges// ston dus zla ba shar ba na// bdud rtsi'i chu gter gang ba ci// chu shel dkar po chu gter gyi// dbus su song bas ma yin nam// nags kyi dga' ma dpag bsam la// rtag par 'khril ba'i rgyu ci zhig /yal ga'i lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// me tog bzhin mdangs gsal bas so// bcom ldan thugs mtsho nyag gcig gis// dge legs chu chen bzhi bsdud pa// khong rang gcig pu'i bang mdzod nas// kun gyi phongs pa sel bas yin// nyin byed zer gyis 'thungs pa'i lhag

/yid 'ongs zla tshes gzhon nu ni// nub ri'i shing rta la zhon nas// shar gyi phyogs su dal bus rgyu// nyi gzhon bu mo'i mtshar sdug gis// mal du nyal ba'i zla tshes ni// ngo tsha'i gdong pa rab nyams nas// nub ri'i rtse mor dal gyis babs// zhes sogs rigs pas brtags la sbyar// rgyu zhes bya ba byed pa po// dngos dang dngos med mtshar ba yi// rgyu yi dbye ba rnam pa gsum// dngos po skyed byed rgyu dang ni// shes byed dbye bas rnam pa gnyis// dang po la gsum 'grub pa dang*// rnam 'gyur thos pa'i dbye bas so// dang po la gnyis dngos po dang*// dngos med 'grub par byed pa'o// rnam dpyod ma la ya rlung gis// legs bshad tsandan ljon pa yi// 'dab ma skyod par byed pa 'di// blo gsal dga' ba bskyed pa'i rgyu// zhes pa 'grub pa'i rgyu yi dpe// rigs gnas yongs 'du'i 'gram pa la// rnam dpyod sum rtsen lag pa yis// dal bur gtar ba'i bdud rtsi ni// lto 'gro'i mgrin pa nyams pa rgyu// zhes pa rnam par 'gyur ba'i rgyu// gzhan gyi legs bshad utpal phreng*// rnam dpyod mig zur gyis mnan nas// tshig mdas khyad gsod ltar byed kyang*// bsgrims te rna ba brgyud pa yod// yid la bsam pa gzhan byas nas// sbrang chang mi 'thung zhes brjod kyang*// 'dzum dkar sor mo la brgyus pa'i// mig zur lcags kyus len pa med// ces pa thob pa rgyu yi dpe// nam mkha'i bu mo lang tsho can// nub ri'i mal stan 'khod ma thag /cha shas ma nyams zla bzhin gyi// 'od dkar phreng ba spel ba yod// ces pa dus kyi shes byed rgyu// legs bshad gtam la chags pa ni// bzhin mdangs gsal ba'i mig 'khrul zhing*// se gol mnyam pa'i tog sgra dang*// ngo mtshar can gyi tshig las shes// zhes pa gzhan sems dpog pa'i rgyu// khyod kyi mkhyen rab pad dkar ni// tshig legs shing rta'i khrir bzhugs pa'i// don bzang 'od kyi phreng ba can// spel legs nyi ma'i mdangs kyis mtshon// zhes pa bya ba mtshon pa'i dpe// slob dpon mkhas pa ma bsten cing*// rig pa'i gnas la ma sbyangs pas// gang la'ang blo gros ma phyogs pa// 'di yis khyod blo nges par brdungs// zhes pa dngos med rgyu yi dpe// legs bshad lang tsho'i ri mo ni// gsal bar bris pa ma yin na// rnam dpyod ldan pa'i smin legs ma// grang mo'i chu yis mthar byar 'gyur// zhes pa ma yin dgag pa'i dpe// mtshar ba'i rgyu la rnam pa lnga// khyod kyi legs bshad lcags kyu ni// blo gsal 'ga' la 'phangs pa na// ma 'phangs gzhan gyi blo gros kyang*// mgyogs par bzung ba 'di ngo mtshar// zhes pa ring ba'i rgyu yi dpe// khyod kyi legs bshad mtshar sdug can// mgrin pa'i khri la 'khod pa dang*// kho bo'i rnam dpyod me long gi

/ngos la lhan cig shar byas pa// lhan cig skyes pa'i rgyu yi dpe// 'char kha'i mdangs gsal khyod zhal nas// bsdus don sa chen bcad tsam gyis// legs bshad rgya mtsho lhag par gang*// tshig don zla ba dal gyis shar// zhes pa 'bras bu sngar skyes rgyu// khyod zhal nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la// sgrib byed sprin gyis ma bsgribs pa// mthong ma thag tu sa skyong rnams// lag pa'i pad mo zum par byed// ces pa rigs pa min pa'i rgyu// zhabs sen zla 'od gzhon nu ma// sa skyong gtsug gi ku mud mtshor// lhung ma thag tu lag pa yi// pad mo zum par byed pa dge /zhes pa rigs pa'i rgyu yin no// bsam pa'i don de mi brjod par// lus kyi brda tsam bstan pa ni// phra mo yin no de yi dpe// 'dod lha 'ga' zhig chags pa yis// zung mig bung ba spro byed na// 'dzum gyi pad dkar mdangs kyis bsdu// dga' ba'i mkhur 'dzum g.yo ldan na// zur mig lcags kyu ring pos 'dzin// zhes sogs rigs pas sbyar bar bya// cha shas gzhan gyi dngos po yi// rang bzhin gsal bar sgrib byed pa// cha yi rgyan du grags pa ste// rang snying lang tsho ldan ma la// nges par song ba sgrib 'dod nas// sring mo khyod kyi mig ngos la// rtsub mo'i rngul dag song zhes sam// mdzes ma mthong ba'i kun dga' yis// 'chi ma 'bab pa sgrib 'dod nas// kho bo'i mig tu rngul song zhes// mkhas par zer ba de las sogs// dgon pa zhi ba'i nags khrod na// rtse dga'i grogs kyis khrod bor zhing*// rnyed dang bkur stis khyod btang nas// khengs pa skyungs pa khyod gcig dman// zhes pa smad pa'i cha yis bsgribs// grags pa'i khri la rab 'dug nas// rnyed bkur nor bu'i bsil yab 'chang*// rtag tu brtse zhing dga' ba yis// rnam rol dge slong khyod rgyal po// zhes pa bstod pa'i cha yis bsgribs// khyad gzhi dngos po rnams kyi ni// khyad chos rim pa ltar mtshon pa// rim pa can gyi rgyan du bsngags// dbyangs can dpal mo'i 'dzum dkar dang*// snyan gong 'dzegs pa'i spyan dkyus dang*// zhi zhing sgeg pa'i bzhugs stangs kyis// pad dkar phreng ba skyong byed cing*// snyan gong utpal zil gyis mnan// 'gro rnams dbang du sdud ces sam// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba ni// 'khrul med ca co ga la mnga'// mnyam par bzhag pa mi g.yo ba// khyod la rtag par phyag bgyi'o// mchog tu dga' ba bskyed pa ni// dga' ba'i rgyan du bshad pa ste// 'di ni nyams kyi bye brag yin// yid 'ongs rnams dang ldan pa ni// nyams ldan rgyan du bshad pa yin// rab mdzes rma bya'i khrir 'khod pa'i// smin legs drug ldan khyim der 'ongs// de 'dra'i dga' ba ya mtshan can// khyod nyid mdun du 'ongs dang mtshungs// legs bshad 'khril shing gzhon nu yis// rnam dpyod yid 'ongs ljon pa la// rtag par 'khril ba'i dga' ston 'dis// mi'am ci mo'i reg 'jam 'phrog

/ces pa 'di ni dga' ba'i nyams// dbyangs can zhal gyi padma la// 'dren byed bung ba'i rnam rol gyis// bdud rtsi 'thung ba 'di btang nas// 'dab brgya'i skyed tshal gsar pas ci// zhes pa sgeg pa'i nyams ldan no// mthar byed gshin rje mi bzad pa// srog la rngam pa'i mche ba can// mchong zhing rgyug pa mdun 'ongs pa'i// lus can 'di dag srog 'tsho'am// zhes pa drag po'i nyams ldan no// dpung tshogs yan lag ma bshams shing*// khong khro'i mtshon cha ma brdar bar// 'khor ba'i g.yul ngo bzlog pa yi// 'jig rten las 'das dpa' bo khyod// rjes 'jug slob bu'i dpung tshogs ni// yan lag bzhi pos rab bteg nas// rnam dpyod shing rta'i khrir 'dug pa// khyod ni chos kyi rgyal por 'os// zhes pa dpa' ba'i nyams ldan no// pad ma'i mal stan 'jam po la// bdud rtsi'i 'tsho ba btab 'os pa'i// drin chen ma de gshin rje'i kha// mi bzad der song 'di bzod dam// zhes pa snying rje'i nyams yin no// mi shes mthar byed khyod kyis ni// ral gris bsad pa'i gti mug gi /che na smyon pa'i khrag rnams ni// ye shes thod rlon snod kyis 'thungs// zhes pa mi sdug nyams ldan no// lha mo'i mdzes sdug 'od nyid kyis// utpal phreng ba rnyings sam ci// zur mig mda' de snyan shal gyi// rgyan phreng mdza' bo la 'phangs sam// ces pa rgod pa'i nyams ldan no// lo ma'i gur khang 'thibs po na// 'khri shing dga' mas dam 'khril ba'i// lang tsho ldan pa'i ljon phreng la// ma li gsar pas bzhad cing rgod// me tog nor bu'i bsil yab kyi// tog can lo ma'i gdugs mdzes kyi// phreng bas brgyan pa'i nags khrod kyi// khang bzang yid 'ongs 'di yod kyi// zhes pa 'di 'dra ngo mtshar rgyan// brgya byin khros pa'i rdo rje ni// rtse mo brgya pa'i shugs 'chang des// mi bsrun stobs ldan dpung bcas pa// sa 'og mun pa'i 'og tu bcug

/ces pa 'jigs su rung ba'i rgyan// brgya byin khros pa'i rdo rje yis// lha min yul nas 'byin nus kyang*// mun pa'i mal du nyal ba na// mdzangs pa'i stabs kyis bde bar bzhag /ces pa gzi brjid can gyi dpe// lang tsho can dag dal bar bzhugs// kho mos sa ha ka ra yi// snye ma khu byug gis zos pa// dal bus bzlog par bgyi'o zhes// gzhan gyi 'dod don bsgrub bya'i phyir// grangs brjod pa yi dpe yin drang*// sgrub par dka' ba'i bya ba zhig /sgrub byed nus pa phun tshogs pa// gang de kun tu phan pa'i rgyan// re thag bcad pas slong mo pas// phyug po'i rkang par phyag byed pa'i// tshig mda' bzod par dka' ba de// 'byor ldan snying la 'dod lhas bsnun// nyi mas spangs pa'i sa chen 'di// mun par gyur nas rab rmongs pa// de tshe 'od dkar brgya ldan 'di// brgya byin gyis ni gsar du byin// zhes pa kun tu phan pa'i dpe// rgya che ba dang brling ba yis// gang de chen por mtshon byed pa// rgya che ba yi rgyan du bshad// lang ga mgrin bcu mthar byed pa'i// dpa' bo ra ma ṇa de ni// bla ma'i zhal las mi 'da' bas// chen po'i ngang tshul gsal bar bstan// shing rta bcu pas rgyal srid ni// drang srong bha ra tar byin nas// dgra bo 'joms pa'i bu la ni// nags su song zhes brjod par grags// rin chen rtsig pa la 'phos pa'i// gzugs brnyan brgya yis bskor gyur pa'i// mgrin bcu'i bdag nyid de kho na// ha nu ma das brtags nas shes// bud med mdzangs ma brgyas bskor ba'i// kong jo'i bu mo bho ṭa yi// blon po mdzangs pas brtags zhes grags// zhes pa 'di dag rim bzhin du// bsam pa'i bdag nyid rgya che dang*// brling ba yi ni rgya che ba// snyon nas brjod bya'i khyad par ni// 'ga' zhig ston pa bsnyon dor rgyan// rgyal ba la ni mkhyen brtse yi// mda' gnyis po las med pa min// 'dod lha'i dpung las rgyal byed pa'i// dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi yang yod// ces pa chos la bsnyon pa'o// ma la ya rlung shing rta la// nye bar zhon pa'i tsandan dri// zla 'od 'jam po'i gos can 'dis// gang 'dir me yi rang bzhin spro// zhes pa yul gyi bsnyon dor yin// bzhin bzang ldan pa'i ri bong can// bdud rtsi'i 'od can yin par grags// gang gi snying la 'dod pa yis// phongs pa'i chad pa rab skyed byed// ces pa rang bzhin bsnyon dor ro// dpe yi bsnyon dor la sogs ni// gong du bshad zin de dag go

/tshig gcig gis ni brjod bya'i don// mang po sbyar ba sbyar ba'i rgyan// gtsug rgyan la gnas yid 'ong ba// 'jam pa'i gsung zer snyoms pa yis// 'jig rten kun gyi yid 'dzin pa// 'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la gnas// zhes pas rgyal dang zla ba yi// don gnyis go bar byed pa yod// de yi dbye ba 'di ltar zung*// don gnyis bya ba gcig pa dang*// bya ba tha dad mi 'gal dang*// bya ba nges par 'gal ba dang*// sbyar yang nges par bzung ba dang*// nges par bzung bas gzhan 'gog dang*// khyad chos chos can gnyis ka la// mi 'gal ba dang 'gal ba dang*// dper brjod rim bzhin bstan bya ba// zur mig lcags kyu ring po dang*// dal bar rgyu ba'i pho nya mo// gnyis kas mdza' mo 'gugs pa yi// bya ba gcig la 'jug par byed// yid 'ongs chags pa'i 'phel ba dang*// 'jam zhing gsal ba'i 'tsher bag can// khu byug dang ni mdzes ma gnyis// mthong dang reg byar mi 'gal dpe// tshad pas lus kyi drod 'phel zhing*// dmar 'od 'khyug pa'i zhal ldan pa// tsha zer can de nus pa dang*// legs par shar ba mnyam du byas// zhes pa nyi ma chags pa la// sbyar yang bya ba 'gal ba dpe// shing rta la zhon dmar 'od can// tsha ba'i zer gyis lus gdung ba// dga' ba'i padma rgyas byed 'di// mtshan mo'i thun la nges par shar// zhes pas nyi dang chags pa gnyis// brjod kyang cig shos nges par bzung*// mgrin pa'i nang nas snyan sgrogs shing*// myos pa'i mig gnyis dmar zhing 'phrul// mdza' bo 'gugs pa'i lus 'gyur can// mda' yab ngos la rgyu'o zhes// phug ron dga' ma bzung bas na// mi mo 'gog par byed pa yin// nyi ma dang ni rgyal po gnyis// gzi brjid ldan dang kun la snyoms// shing rtar zhugs nas yul kun myul// 'char kha'i phun tshogs ltad mo yis// 'jig rten pa kun dga' bar byed// ces pa chen po gnyis kyis ni// khyad chos mi 'gal ba yi dpe// rgyal po dang ni zla ba gnyis// gzi brjid ldan zhing bram zes bkur// zhal mdangs gsal zhing nyams mi mnga'// mthon po'i khri la rtag par bzhugs// zhes pa khyad chos 'gal ba'i dpe// rgyu yi khyad par ma tshang yang*// 'bras bu bskrun pa'i nus pa ni// brjod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i rgyan// me tog gzhu can khyod kyi mda'// rtsub mo ma yin rno ba'ang min// de ltar na yang sa gsum las// rnam par rgyal ba 'di ya mtshan// zhes pa yon tan bral ba'i dpe// lha min bu mo ma yin zhing*// mi'am ci mo ga la yin// de lta na yang bde 'byung gi

/dka' thub bzlog par 'di byas so// zhes pa rigs dang bral ba'i dpe// khro gnyer dpung tshogs ma bsdus shing*// mche ba'i zhags pa ma brkyang bar// dgra bo phyi phyir phyogs byed pa'i// dgra thabs shes 'di dpa' bo yin// zhes pa bya ba bral ba'i dpe// dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi med cing*// dpa' zhing rngam pa'i sdang med par// mig zur gcig pus 'jig rten las// rnam par rgyal ba'i dbyangs can ma// zhes pa rdzas dang bral ba'i dpe// shing rta'i 'khor lo mi mnyam zhing*// kha lo pa yi yan lag nyams// rta yang zung du ma sbrel bar// mkha' la mgyogs par 'gro ba yin// zhes pa rgyu dang bral ba yi// khyad par brjod pa'i dpe yin no// khyad chos mtshungs par sbyar ba ni// mtshungs par sbyar ba'i rgyan yin te// khyed dang lha yi dbang po dang*// khyod kyi mtshon dang dbang po yi// rdo rje kho na rang gi ni// mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal// zhes pa yon tan mtshungs pa'i dpe// 'brug gi phreng ba'i sgra dbyangs dang*// glog gi rol rtsed me tog dang*// smin legs ldan pa'i reg 'jam ni// skad cig nyid kyis rnam par g.yo// zhes pa skyon rnams mtshungs pa'i dpe// dngos po 'gal ba rnams 'grogs pa// de ni 'gal ba'i rgyan yin te// de yi dbye ba drug bshad bya// ston gyi nam mkha' dwangs pa na// ngang pa'i rgyal po dbyangs snyan zhing*// gdugs mdzes g.yo ldan rma bya'i skad// rna ba'i bcud rnams 'phrog par byed// ces pa khyad gzhi so so yi// bya ba 'gal ba'i dpe yin grag /chu 'dzin gsar pa'i rlabs phreng gis// nam mkha'i mdzes pa phrogs nas ni// rang gi mdzes pa rnam par spel// zhes pa yon tan 'gal ba'i dpe// sku smad sbom zhing sku sked phra// nu ma mtho zhing gsung gdangs dma'// mkhur tshos dmar zhing sha mdangs dkar// dri zhim bsil bas gzhan sreg byed// ces pa rdzas dang 'gal ba'i dpe// tsandan dkar po'i dri bsung dang*// zla ba'i 'od zer spro mdzad mas// 'ga' zhig yid la tshad pa yi// gdung ba bskyed par byas zhes pa// las dang yon tan 'gal ba'i dpe// dbyangs can lha mo'i lus drod kyis// reg par min pa 'ga' zhig gis// lus la tshad pa'i me 'bar zhing*// yid kyi skom pa bsal zhes pa// gzhi gcig bya ba 'gal ba'i dpe// mgrin bcu shing rta bcu pa yi// bu mo dag la rab song nas// ra ma ṇa la brten no zhes// yid brtan byed po su zhig yod// ces pa sbyar ba'i 'gal ba can// gang zhig gzhan la smad 'dod nas// skabs min gzhan la bstod pa ni// skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan ces bya// seng ges bsrung ba'i nags khrod na// dul ba'i ri dwags gzhon nu dag

/bsags bsrung mi dgos kha zas kyi// sman gyis bde bar 'tsho de dge /smad pa lta bus yon tan ni// sgrogs pa zol bstod rgyan ces bshad// mi'u thung gis kyang sa gsum mo// rnam par mnan pa ma yin nam// dregs ldan rgyal pos sa gsum las// rnam par rgyal ba ci ya mtshan// sngon tshe khyod kyi tshul khrims dang*// sbyin pa'i dmag dpung rtsub mo yis// rgyal po gzhan gyi dpa' phrogs nas// mthon por bzhugs pa 'di rigs sam// dregs ldan khyod kyi nga rgyal ni// lhun po'i spo la snyeg mi dgos// khyod kyi zhabs mthil ri mo ni// sa chen gzhi las mnyam par bris// de dang mtshungs pa'i 'bras bu gzhan// ston pa nges par bstan pa yin// 'jam pa'i rang bzhin lha gcig gis// thor cog mig sman mdangs 'dzin pa// chags pa'i bud shing bsreg pa yi// du ba 'khyil bar gsal bar mtshon// khro mdzad lhag pa'i lha gang gis// ral gri me ri dmar gsal ba// zhe sdang mthar byed bsad pa yi// khrag gi ri mo yin par mtshon// nyi ma'i 'od kyis padmo yi// ge sar rnam rgyal dgod byed pa// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'od zer gyis// bstan pa'i skyed tshal rgyas par mtshon// thun mtshams dbu mos drag po yi// cod pan spyi bor blangs pa ni// mi mkhas rnams kyang chen po yi// rjes su 'jug pa nye bar mtshon// chos can mang po'i yon tan rnams// las rnams lhan cig brjod pa ni// lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan yin no// mkhas pa'i legs bshad dal 'gros can// chu bo bzhi dang lhan cig 'bab// nyi zlas spangs pa'i gos 'chang ma// mi mkhas blo dang lhan cig 'jug /ces pa yon tan lhan cig brjod// shes rab ldan pa'i 'jug pa ni// nyi ma'i 'od dang lhan cig 'phro// mi mkhas rnams kyi mun pa ni// rgyu skar phreng ldan ma dang 'phrogs// bya ba tha dad lhan cig brjod// nags kyi khu byug snyan sgrogs dang*// tsandan bsil ba'i dri bzangs dang*// dpyid kyi dga' ba nyer spel ba// 'di dag mnyam du lhag par 'phel// zhes pa bya ba gcig nyid ni// lhan cig brjod pa'i dpe yin no// phan tshun bsnol zhing brjes pa ni// yongs su brjes pa'i rgyan yin dpe// khyod sngon sbyin pa'i shing rta yis// longs spyod dza hnu'i bu mo blangs// khyod kyi thugs rje'i rgyun chen ni// phangs pa med par gzhan la sbyin// gzhan gyi grags pa'i pad dkar gyi// do shal ring po khyod kyis bsnams// kho bo'i rnam dpyod lag pa yis// khyod la gces pa'i legs bshad nor// 'ga' dag ma byin par yang blangs// de la lhag par dgyes pa dang*// brtse ba'i lcags kyu ring po yis// bdag snying dad pa'i glang po dang*// rab gus ku mud phreng ba ni// gtsug rgyan 'od dang lhan cig drangs// mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos po la// smon pas shes pa brjod pa yin// nyon mongs mi bsrun dpung bcom nas// dngos 'dzin dbang rim la 'gongs te// yon tan rnam rgyal khang bzang la// goms stabs grims pos 'jug byed shog

/mi sdug drag po'i nyams kyis ni// gzhan sde dregs pa'i dpung bcom nas// sgeg cing snying rje'i nyams kyis ni// rang sde rjes su 'dzin byed shog /rgyan rnams mi 'dra bsres pa ni// spel ma'i rgyan du brjod pa yin// khyod zhal rang bzhin mdzes pa mchog /zla ba'i 'od ltar 'dzum phreng gsal// de nas zla ba'i dpal la yang*// 'gong nus nyi ma'i zhal ldan ma// phan tshun ltos pa'i spel mar bshad// khyod sku rang bzhin nyid kyis mdzes// gang gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar snyan// nyid thugs rgya mtsho'i khengs pa 'phrog /phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' dang 'grogs// zhes pa phan tshun mi ltos pa'i// spel mar bshad pa 'di zung zhig /tshig rnams phan tshun ltos pa las/ dngos su brjod pa ma yin pa'i// khyad par zab mo gzhan go ba// de ni dgongs pa'i rgyan zhes grags// dang por thugs mchog rab bskyed de// bar du tshogs gnyis rdzogs byas nas// lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa yi// phrin las can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa mchod yul sangs rgyas su// go bar byed pa dgongs pa'i rgyan// don rgyan sum cu rtsa lnga po// so so'i dbye ba dang bcas pa// shin tu go bar sla ba yi// tshig dang rgyan gyi sgo nas ni// ma lus rgyas par bshad pa 'dis// sgra dang sdeb sbyor mi shes pa'i// byis pa yis kyang snyan dngags kyi// gnas pa blo gros dkar bar 'gyur// tshig rgyan gyi bstan bcos me long la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba las/ don rgyan rnam par bshad pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //lha dbang lha yi gar mkhan ma de bzhin// bzhin bzangs bzhin gyi rnam 'gyur spro mkhan ma// ma ltar ma lus 'gro la brtse ba'i dbyangs// dbyangs can dbyangs kyi phreng ba spel khyod spyon// sgra yi rgyan ces bya ba gsum// spyir btang zung ldan tsam po dang*// khyad par bya dka'i bye brag dang*// dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka'o// dang po rnam pa drug yin te// rkang pa'i dang por zung ldan dang*// bar dang tha ma'i zung ldan dang*// thog mtha' sbyar ba'i zung ldan dang*// kun tu zung ldan 'dres pa yi// zung ldan bzlog pa'i zung ldan no// dang po gsum la'ang chod pa yi// zung ldan chod pa'i zung ldan dang*// chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan// dang po rnam pa bzhi yin te// rkang pa gcig pa gnyis pa dang*// gsum pa bzhi pa la yod do// brgya phrag brgya byin gyis mchod pa'i// thub pa nyid dang dam pa'i chos// 'phags tshogs de yi yon tan dang*// ngo mtshar 'phrin las mtha' yas so// thub pa'i zhabs sen dmar 'od ni// nye dbang dbang po'i gtsug gi rgyan// bstan pa 'chi med bdud rtsi dang*// dge 'dun pad dkar phreng ba yang*// kho bo'i gtsug rgyan nor bu'i khrir// ngal stegs mdzad pa'i slob dpon ni// shes rab shes bya'i gnas la 'gro// thugs rjes 'gro rnams rjes su 'dzin// mkhas pa khyod kyis bshad pa dang*// mang
